About ArchSpex

The specification platform built for GCC Projects

Connect specification-ready products with architects, designers, developers and contractors across the GCC.

Our Mission

Connecting Specification-Ready Products with GCC Projects

Architects, designers, developers and contractors often spend significant time searching for suitable products, technical documentation and reliable manufacturers.

ArchSpex was created to simplify this process by bringing specification-ready products, BIM resources, technical documents and manufacturer information together in one platform built for GCC projects.

Our mission is to help professionals discover, evaluate and specify products more efficiently while helping manufacturers connect with the teams shaping tomorrow's projects.

Built specifically for architects, designers, developers, contractors and international manufacturers active in GCC projects.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers about ArchSpex, product discovery, brand listings and platform memberships.

General

What is ArchSpex?+−
ArchSpex is a curated specification platform connecting architects, designers, developers, contractors and manufacturers across GCC projects.
Is ArchSpex free to use?+−
Yes. Product discovery, product research and specification resources are available free of charge for construction professionals.
Which countries does ArchSpex cover?+−
ArchSpex focuses on GCC projects, including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman, with selected visibility across the wider Middle East.
Are all products verified?+−
All manufacturers and product listings are reviewed before publication to maintain platform quality and relevance.

For Professionals

Who can use ArchSpex?+−
Architects, designers, developers, contractors, procurement teams and other construction professionals.
Can I download BIM and CAD files?+−
Yes. Manufacturers may upload BIM models, CAD drawings and technical resources where available.
Can I request product samples?+−
Yes. Sample requests can be submitted directly through the platform.
Can I submit RFQs?+−
Yes. Professionals can request quotations from manufacturers through ArchSpex.
Does ArchSpex sell products directly?+−
No. ArchSpex connects professionals with manufacturers and suppliers but does not sell products directly.

For Brands

Who can list products on ArchSpex?+−
Manufacturers, distributors and product brands relevant to GCC construction and design projects.
Is every brand accepted?+−
No. Applications are reviewed to ensure product relevance, quality and suitability for the platform.
What information can be included in a listing?+−
Brand profiles, product information, technical documents, BIM files, certifications, images and project references.
How long does the review process take?+−
Most applications are reviewed within 2 business days.

Memberships & Listings

What membership plans are available?+−
ArchSpex offers Essential, Professional and Enterprise membership levels designed to support different visibility and specification objectives.
Are membership prices published online?+−
Membership plans are discussed directly with manufacturers to ensure the most suitable package and visibility strategy.
Can I upgrade my membership later?+−
Yes. Brands may upgrade their membership level at any time.
What visibility opportunities are available?+−
Options include featured listings, homepage placements, category sponsorships and newsletter features.
Still Have Questions?

Our team is happy to help.

Reach out to the ArchSpex team for support, brand applications, partnership enquiries, or platform questions.

Terms of Service

Effective Date: 01.05.2026

1. Acceptance of Terms

Welcome to ArchSpex.

ArchSpex is a digital specification and product discovery platform owned and operated by GTV Global L.L.C., Dubai, United Arab Emirates (“GTV Global”, “ArchSpex”, “we”, “our”, or “us”).

By accessing, browsing, registering for, or using the ArchSpex platform, website, services, content, tools, directories, databases, product listings, manufacturer profiles, BIM resources, technical documentation, RFQ services, sample request services, or any related functionality (collectively, the “Platform”), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

If you do not agree to these Terms, you must immediately discontinue use of the Platform.

We reserve the right to refuse access to any user, manufacturer, organization, or visitor at our sole discretion.

2. Platform Services

ArchSpex provides a digital platform designed to facilitate the discovery, evaluation, specification, promotion, and communication of building materials, construction products, interior products, systems, and related services.

The Platform may include:

  • Manufacturer profiles
  • Product listings
  • Technical documentation
  • BIM and CAD resources
  • Certifications and compliance documents
  • Product images and marketing materials
  • RFQ functionality
  • Sample request functionality
  • Project-related information
  • Visibility and advertising opportunities
  • Membership and subscription services

ArchSpex acts solely as an information and communication platform.

ArchSpex is not a manufacturer, supplier, distributor, contractor, consultant, engineer, architect, procurement agent, reseller, importer, exporter, or project manager.

ArchSpex does not participate in product transactions between users and manufacturers.

3. User Accounts

Users may be required to create an account to access certain features.

Users agree to:

  • Provide accurate information
  • Maintain the security of login credentials
  • Keep account information current
  • Accept responsibility for all activities under their account

ArchSpex may suspend, restrict, or terminate any account at its sole discretion without prior notice.

Users may not:

  • Share login credentials
  • Impersonate another person or company
  • Create multiple fraudulent accounts
  • Use the Platform for unlawful purposes
  • Attempt unauthorized access to the Platform

4. Manufacturer Listings

Manufacturer participation on ArchSpex is subject to review and approval.

ArchSpex reserves the right to:

  • Accept or reject any manufacturer application
  • Remove listings at any time
  • Request additional documentation
  • Modify listing requirements
  • Reorganize product categories

Manufacturers are solely responsible for:

  • Product descriptions
  • Technical data
  • Certifications
  • BIM files
  • CAD files
  • Images

Cookie Policy

Effective Date: 01.05.2026

1. Introduction

This Cookie Policy explains how ArchSpex (“Platform”, “ArchSpex”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit or interact with our website and services.

ArchSpex is a digital specification platform operated by GTV Global L.L.C., Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

By continuing to use the Platform, you acknowledge the use of cookies as described in this Cookie Policy.

2. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your computer, smartphone, tablet, or other device when you visit a website.

Cookies help websites function efficiently, remember user preferences, improve user experience, and provide information about website usage and performance.

Cookies may be temporary (“session cookies”) or remain on your device for a period of time (“persistent cookies”).

3. Why We Use Cookies

ArchSpex uses cookies and similar technologies to:

  • Ensure proper operation of the Platform
  • Maintain user sessions
  • Remember user preferences
  • Improve website functionality
  • Analyze platform performance
  • Understand user behaviour
  • Enhance security
  • Prevent fraud and misuse
  • Measure marketing effectiveness
  • Improve user experience

4. Types of Cookies We Use

A. Essential Cookies

These cookies are necessary for the operation of the Platform and cannot be disabled.

Examples include:

  • User authentication
  • Session management
  • Security controls
  • Account login functionality
  • Form submission functionality

Without these cookies, certain Platform features may not operate correctly.

B. Functional Cookies

These cookies help remember user preferences and settings.

Examples include:

  • Language preferences
  • User interface settings
  • Region preferences
  • Saved preferences

These cookies improve convenience and user experience.

C. Analytics Cookies

Analytics cookies help us understand how visitors interact with the Platform. Information collected may include:

  • Pages visited
  • Time spent on pages
  • Navigation behaviour
  • Search activity
  • Device information
  • Traffic sources

Analytics information is used to improve Platform performance and usability.

D. Performance Cookies

These cookies help us measure website performance and identify technical issues.

Examples include:

  • Page loading performance
  • Error tracking
  • System diagnostics
  • Platform optimization
E. Marketing Cookies

Marketing cookies may be used to:

  • Measure campaign performance
  • Improve marketing communications
  • Understand user interests
  • Deliver relevant content
  • Analyze newsletter engagement

Marketing cookies may be placed by ArchSpex or approved third-party service providers.

5. Third-Party Cookies

ArchSpex may use third-party services that place cookies on the Platform.

Such services may include:

  • Analytics providers
  • Hosting providers
  • Communication platforms
  • CRM systems
  • Marketing platforms
  • Newsletter platforms
  • Advertising partners

These third parties operate under their own privacy and cookie policies. ArchSpex does not control the cookies placed by third-party providers.

6. How to Manage Cookies

Most web browsers allow users to:

  • View stored cookies
  • Delete cookies
  • Block cookies
  • Restrict cookie usage
  • Receive notifications when cookies are placed

Users may manage cookie settings through their browser preferences.

Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect the functionality and performance of the Platform.

7. Cookie Consent

Where required by applicable law, ArchSpex may request user consent before placing certain categories of cookies on a user’s device.

Users may withdraw or modify cookie preferences at any time through available cookie settings or browser controls.

8. Data Collected Through Cookies

Information collected through cookies may include:

  • IP address
  • Browser information
  • Device information
  • Operating system
  • Session information
  • User preferences
  • Website interactions
  • Referral sources
  • Usage statistics

Such information is processed in accordance with the ArchSpex Privacy Policy.

9. Data Retention

Cookie-related information is retained only for as long as reasonably necessary to:

  • Operate the Platform
  • Improve services
  • Analyze performance
  • Meet legal obligations
  • Protect legitimate business interests

Retention periods may vary depending on the type of cookie and its purpose.
